_comment: Copy to manifest.json. Put the PDFs you downloaded from the official GATE site in data/gate_papers/raw/. One entry per question paper (per set/session). Do not invent URLs - paste the real ones you used.

papers.source_url: <official URL of the question paper PDF>
papers.key_url: <official URL of the answer key PDF>
papers.license: <usage terms stated by the source site>
